workspaceTests.method: One final result per test file across workspace commands and targeted rechecks; overlapping executions not counted twice.
workspaceTests.note: The first full attempt was stopped during fixture timeouts under parallel load. A later invocation repeated --maxWorkers for eight workspace scripts and was rejected before their tests ran; those workspaces were run with their maintained commands. Nine files were subsequently rechecked (131 passed) after transient initialization/time-budget failures. This is a composite verification, not a claim that one npm run check command passed.
